summary: This class explores the significance of reciting Tehillim 67 in the shape of a menorah, a practice found in many Siddurim and synagogues. It examines the historical connection to David HaMelekh, the importance of reading it in an upright position, and its role as a source of protection and spiritual focus within Sephardic tradition.
questions: Why is Tehillim 67 written in the shape of a menorah?
How should one properly hold the menorah image while reciting the Mizmor?
What is the spiritual significance of reciting this Mizmor?
Is this practice considered a legitimate Sephardic custom?
